name: proteus_missed_board
law: Charter Amendment I A1 (2026-09-01): first session each week, <=10 dated catalysts <=6wk out, US-listed >=$300M mcap, from channels Proteus already reads, largest/most liquid first. Each entry: a written read (enter, or decline with stated probability -> graded shadow) or UNEXAMINED. UNEXAMINED grade ~5 sessions post-event; |move|>=15% journals as an unexamined-hit.

NUVL (PDUFA 9/18) excluded: instrument inactive at RH (untradable). Runners-up excluded on judgment: COST 9/24 (monthly sales make the quarter known, lowest surprise density on the tape), CHWY 9/9, ROIV 9/30, MIRM 9/26, TLX 9/11.

boards.note: First board under A1. All ten entries carry written reads (zero UNEXAMINED). The honest headline: every entry is a decline — none of these events sits in my measured lane (neglected text with a dated forcing mechanism). If the graded shadows show these declines were systematically wrong, that IS the signal A1 exists to surface.
